English: This chapter summarizes recommendations on important aspects of the management of patients with severe malaria and severe dengue.
Luganda: Essuula eno efunza ebyasembebwa eby’omugaso ku nzijanjaba y’abalwadde abalina omusujja ogw’amaanyi n’omusujja dengue ogw’amaanyi.
Yoruba: Orí yìí ṣe ìsọníṣókí àwọn àbá lórí ohun tí ó ṣe pàtàkì nínú ìṣàkóso àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n ní Àìsàn Ibà tí ó burú jáì àti iba Dengue tí ó le púpọ̀.
Zulu: Lesi sahluko sifingqa izincomo ezicini ezibalulekile zokuphatha iziguli ezinomalaleveva onzima kanye nodenga olunzima.
Hausa: Wannan babi ya taƙaita shawarwari ne game da muhimman al’amura na kula da marasa lafiya da suke fama da cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro da kuma zazzaɓin karya ƙashi mai tsanani.
Northern Sotho: Kgaolo ye e fa kakaretšo ya ditšhišinyo ka ga dilo tše bohlokwa tša taolo ya balwetši bao ba nago le letadi leo le kekilego le dengue yeo e kekilego.
Amharic: ይህ ምእራፍ ከባድ የወባ እና ከባድ የዴንጊ ሕመም ያለባቸው ታካሚዎችን አያያዝ አስፈላጊ በሆኑ ጉዳዮች ላይ ምክሮችን ያጠቃልላል።

English: Severe falciparum malaria requires rapid parasitological diagnosis by microscopy or rapid diagnostic test (RCT) and prompt initiation of parenteral artesunate.
Luganda: Omusujja ogw’amaanyi oguva ku falciparum gwetaaga okukebera kw’obuwuka okw’amangu okukozesa RCT wamu ne prompt initiation of parenteral artesunate.
Yoruba: Ibà fasipárọ́ọ̀mù tí ó burú jáì nílò ìsàmúlò ẹ̀rọ̀ awokòkòrò láti ṣe àṣàyẹ̀wò párásáìtì kíákíá tàbí àyẹ̀wò (RCT) ìdámọ̀ àìsàn kíákíá àti bíbẹ̀rẹ̀ ìtọ́jú láti gbógun ti àìsàn náà.
Zulu: Umalaleveva onzima we-falciparum udinga ukuxilongwa okusheshayo kwe-parasitological nge-microscopy noma ukuhlolwa kokuxilonga okusheshayo (RCT) kanye nokuqalwa ngokushesha kwe-parenteral artesunate.
Hausa: Zazzaɓin Cizon Sauro mai tsanani na falsifaram yana buƙatar saurin ganewa ta hanyar microscofi ko gwajin gaggawa (RCT) da kuma saurin faraw allurar artesunate.
Northern Sotho: Letadi leo le kekilego la falciparum le nyaka phekolo ye e tseneletšego ya dipharasaete ka go diriša dimaekherosekopupu goba teko ya phekolo ye e tseneletšego (RCT) le go thomišwa ga ditšhwana tša go hlabja gohle mmeleng.
Amharic: ከባድ የፋልሲፓረም ወባ በአጉሊ መነጽር ወይም ፈጣን የመመርመሪያ ፍተሻ (RCT) እና ፈጣን የሆነ ከአንጀት ውጪ አርቴሱኔት (የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ የከባድ ወባ በደም ስር የሚሰጥ መድኃኒት) የስነ-ቅልወጣ ምርመራ ያስፈልገዋል።

English: Fluid bolus therapy should be avoided in patients without hypotensive shock, and we suggest initial (24 h) crystalloid fluid therapy of 2–4 mL/kg/h, which may subsequently be reduced to 1 mL/kg/h in patients receiving additional fluids, e.g., through enteral tube feeding.
Luganda: Obujjanjabi bw’omu musaayi bulina okwewalibwa mu balwadde abatafiiriddwa musaayi, era tuteesa okusooka okuliisibwa mu kaseke (essaawa 24) okwa 2–4 mL/kg/h okuyinza okukendeezebwa ku 1 mL/kg/h mu balwadde abafuna ebyokunywa ebirala, gamba nga okuteeka emmere mu lubuto ng’eyita mu kaseke.
Yoruba: Ó yẹ kí a yẹra fún Ìtọ́jú àìlera tí a mọ̀ sí Fluid bolus fún àwọn aláìsàn tí wọn kò ní ẹ̀jẹ̀ ríru òjiji, bẹ́ẹ̀ náà ni a gbàá ní ìmọ̀ràn kí wọ́n ṣe ìtọ́jú àìlera fífúni-ni omi crystalloid láti inú iṣan fún (24 h) àkọ́kọ́ ní 2–4 ml/kg/h, ní èyí tí ó ṣe é ṣe kí a dínkù sí 1 ml/kg/h ní ara àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n ń gba àfikun omi, bí àpẹẹrẹ, láti ara túùbù ìfúnnilóúnjẹ.
Zulu: Ukwelashwa kwe-fluid bolus kufanele kugwenywe ezigulini ezingenawo ukushaqeka kwe-hypotensive, futhi siphakamisa ukwelapha kokuqala (24 h) i-crystalloid fluid ye-2-4 mL/kg/h, okungenzeka kamuva kwehliswe ku-1 mL/kg/h ezigulini ezithola uketshezi olwengeziwe., isb., ngokusebenzisa i-enteral tube feed.
Hausa: Ya kamata a guji maganin bolus na ruwa a cikin marasa lafiya ba tare da rashin bugawar jini a zuciya ba, kuma muna bayar da shawarar ƙarin ruwa na farko (sa’o’i 24) na 2–4 mL/kg/h, wanda daga baya za a iya rage shi zuwa 1 mL/kg/h a cikin marasa lafiya da suke karɓar ƙarin ruwa. misali, ta hanyar bututun ciyarwa na hanci.
Northern Sotho: Kalafo ka dijo tša ka dieeleng e swanetše go efogwa go balwetši ba go hloka tlhaselo ya madi a magolo, ebile re šišinye kalafo ya mathomo (ya diiri tše 24) ka seela sa khristaloete sa 2–4 mL/kg/h, seo ka moragonyana se ka fokotšwago go ya go 1 mL/kg/h go balwetši bao ba hwetšago dieela tša tlalleetšo, go fa mohlala, ka go diela tša phepo ya dijo ka tšhupu ya go tsenywa maleng.
Amharic: የፈሳሽ ቦሉስ ቴራፒ የሃፖቴንሲቭ ድንጋጤ (የአንድ ሰው ደም የሚፈስበት እና ልብ ደምን መግፋት የማይችልበት ሁኔታ) ከሌለባቸው ታካሚዎች መወገድ አለበት፣ እና የመጀመሪያ (24 ሰ) ክሪስታሎይድ ፈሳሽ ህክምና (በጠብታ ፈሳሽን ለታካሚዎች መስጠት) ከ2-4 ሚሊ ሊትር/ኪግ/ሰአት እንጠቁማለን፣ ከዚያም ተጨማሪ ፈሳሽ፣ ለምሳሌ፣ በመግቢያ ቱቦ ምገባ ለሚወስዱ ታካሚዎች ወደ 1 ሚሊ/ኪግ/ሰ ሊቀንስ ይችላል።

English: In the minority of those patients presenting with hypotensive shock, we suggest fluid bolus therapy (30 mL/kg) with an isotonic crystalloid and early initiation of vasopressor support.
Luganda: Mu balwadde abatono ku abo abaali balabika nga baggwaamu omusaayi, tuteesa bafune obujjanjabi bw’omu musaayi (30 mL/kg) wamu ne isotonic crystalloid wamu era n’okuweebwa vasopressor support.
Yoruba: Ìba díẹ̀ nínú àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n ní ẹ̀jẹ̀ ríru òjiji ní a gbàá ní ìmọ̀ràn fún láti ṣe àmúlò Ìtọ́jú àìlera tí a mọ̀ sí Fluid bolus (30 ml/kg) pẹ̀lú isotonic crystalloid àti ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ àtilẹ́yìn ohun èlò amẹ́jẹ̀rusókè kíákíá.
Zulu: Ebancane balezo ziguli ezethula ukushaqeka kwe-hypotensive, siphakamisa ukwelashwa kwe-fluid bolus (30 mL/kg) nge-isotonic crystalloid kanye nokuqaliswa kokuqala kokusekelwa kwe-vasopressor.
Hausa: A cikin ‘yan tsirarun waɗancan marasa lafiya waɗanda suke gabatar da girgizar raguwar hauhawar jini, muna bayar da shawarar maganin bolus na ruwa (30 mL/kg) tare da crystalloid na isotonic da farkon farawa na tallafin ƙara matse hanyoyin jini.
Northern Sotho: Ka go palo ya fase ya balwetši bao bao ba nago le tlhaselo ya madi a magolo, re šišinye kalafo ya dijo tša ka dieleng (30 mL/kg) le khristaloite ya aesothoniki le go thomišwa ga ka pela ga thekgo ya vasopressor.
Amharic: ሃይፖቴንሲቭ ድንጋጤ ከሚያሳዩ ታካሚዎች መካከል ጥቂቶቹ፣ የፈሳሽ ቦሉስ ቴራፒ (30 ሚሊ/ኪግ) በምጥን ክሪስታሎይድ እና የቫሶፕሬሰስ (ዝቅ ያለ የደም ግፊትን ከፍ የሚያደርግ ህክምና) ድጋፍን ቀደም ብሎ መጀመሩን እንጠቁማለን።

English: Enteral feeding in non-intubated adult patients with cerebral malaria can start after 60 h, to avoid aspiration pneumonia.
Luganda: Okussa emmere mu lubuto ng’eyita mu kaseke mu balwadde abakulu abalina omusujja gw’oku bwongo kusobola okutandikira ku 60 h, okwewala emmere okugenda mu mussizo.
Yoruba: Ìfúnnilóúnjẹ láti ẹnu láìṣe àmúlò túùbù ní ara àwọn aláìsàn àgbàlagbà tí wọ́n ní ibà ajẹmọ́pọlọ le è bẹ̀rẹ̀ lẹ́yìn 60 h, láti yẹra fún àìsàn òtútù àyà
Zulu: Ukondla kwamathumbu ezigulini ezikhulile ezingafakwanga ngentuba ezinomalaleveva wobuchopho kungaqala ngemva kwamahora angu-60, ukugwema inyumoniya ye-aspiration.
Hausa: Ciyarwa ta ciki a cikin marasa lafiya da suke farke masu zazzaɓin cizon sauro na ƙwaƙwalwa na manya yana iya farawa bayan sa’o’i 60, domin guje wa ciwon huhu.
Northern Sotho: Phepo ya ditšhupo tša go tsenywa ka maleng go balwetši ba batho ba bagolo bao ba sego ba tsenywa ditšhupu bao ba nago le malaria ya ka bjokong letadi la megalatšjika ya hlogo go ka thomišwa ka morago ga diiri tše 60, go efoga yumonia ya go bakwa ke dijo tša go feta ka tseleng ya moya ka mogolong.
Amharic: በመመገቢያ ቱቦ ምገባ ቱቦ-ሳይቀጠልላቸው ሴሬብራል ወባ ባለባቸው ጎልማሳ ታካሚዎች፣ የሳንባ ምች በሽታን ለማስወገድ ሲባል ከ 60 ሰ በኋላ ሊጀምር ይችላል።

English: There are insufficient data to suggest this in pediatric cerebral malaria.
Luganda: Waliwo obubaka butono ddala obukwanga ensonga eyo ku musujja gw’oku bwongo.
Yoruba: Dátà kò pọ̀ tó láti dá àbá èyí nínú ibà ajẹmọ́pọlọ àwọn ọmọdé.
Zulu: Ayikho idatha eyanele yokuphakamisa lokhu kumalaleveva wobuchopho wezingane.
Hausa: Babu isassun bayanai da za su bayar da shawarar hakan a cikin zazzaɓin cizon sauro na ƙwaƙwalwa na yara.
Northern Sotho: Go na le tshedimošo ye e sego ya felela ya go akanya gore le ke letadi la megalatšhika la bana.
Amharic: በህጻናት ህክምና ሴሬብራል ወባ ላይ ይህንን የሚጠቁሙ በቂ መረጃዎች የሉም።

English: The diagnosis of severe dengue is commonly with a combined dengue antigen (NS1) and antibody RDT.
Luganda: Okukebera kw’omusujja gwa dengue kusinga kulabika na dengue antigen (NS1) wamu n’abasirikale ba RDT.
Yoruba: Ìdámọ̀ àìsàn dengue tí ó burú jáì wọ́pọ̀ pẹ̀lú àdàpọ̀ áńtíjíìnì dengue (NS1) àti oògùn apakòkòrò inú ara RDT.
Zulu: Ukuxilongwa kodenga olunzima kuvame ukuhlanganisa i-antigen yodenga (NS1) kanye ne-RDT yamasosha omzimba.
Hausa: Gano zazzaɓi karya ƙashi mai tsanani yawanci tare da haɗin ƙwayar cutar zazzaɓi karya ƙashi (NS1) da kuma RDT na abakteriyar kariya.
Northern Sotho: Phekolo ya dengue ye e kekilego le antitšene ya dengue ye e kopantšwego (NS1) le dilwelwammele tša RDT.
Amharic: የከባድ የዴንጊ ምርመራ በተለምዶ ከዴንጊ እንግዳ አካል (NS1) እና ፀረ እንግዳ አካል RDT ጋር የተጣመረ ነው።

English: No antiviral treatment is currently available.
Luganda: Tewali bujjanjabi bw’akawuka buliwo mu kiseera kino.
Yoruba: Kò sí ìtọ́jú ìgbógun tí àìsan ìrànmọ́ni nílẹ̀ lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́.
Zulu: Akukho ukwelashwa okulwa namagciwane okutholakalayo okwamanje.
Hausa: A halin yanzu babu maganin rigakafi da yake samuwa.
Northern Sotho: Ga go kalafo ka dianthiretherobaerale yeo e hwetšagalago mo lebakeng le.
Amharic: በአሁኑ ጊዜ የፀረ-ቫይረስ ህክምና የለም።

English: Dengue shock results from capillary leakage, although hemorrhage or depression of myocardial contractility can contribute.
Luganda: Dengue schock kiva ku capillary leakage, wadde nga ekikulukuto oba okwennyika kwa myocardial contractility nakyo kisobola okubuleeta.
Yoruba: Jíjò iṣan tí ó ń gbé ẹ̀jẹ̀ kiri lára ní ó máa ń yọrí sí òjijì Dengue, àmọ́ o jíjò ẹ̀jẹ̀ tàbí àìsàn ìkúruru ìsúnkì ọkàn náà le dá kún ún.
Zulu: Ukushaqeka kodenga kubangelwa ukuvuza kwe-capillary, nakuba ukopha noma ukucindezeleka kwe-myocardial contractility kungaba nomthelela.
Hausa: Girgizar zazzaɓi karya ƙashi tana haifar da zubar da jini, ko da yake zubar jini ko ɓacin rai na ƙanƙancewar zuciya yana iya taimakawa.
Northern Sotho: Tlhaselo ya dengue e bakwa ke go dutla ga megalatšhika ye mesesane, le ge e le gore go dutla ga madi goba kgatelelo ya go ngagega ga myocardial go ka ba le seabe.
Amharic: የዴንጊ ድንጋጤ ከትናንሽ ደም ስሮች የደም መፍሰስ ይመጣል፣ ቢሆንም መድማት ወይም ተፈጥሯዊ የልብ ጡንቻ መሸማቀቅ ድብርትም አስተዋጽኦ ሊያደርግ ይችላል።

English: The World Health Organization guidelines recommend restoration of the circulation guided by pulse pressure, capillary refill time, hematocrit, and urine output.
Luganda: Ebirambiko by’Ekitongole ky’Ensi Yonna eky’Ebyobulamu bisemba okukomyawo entambula y’omusaayi nga kuluŋŋamizibwa entununsi, emisiwa okuddamu okutambuza omusaayi, hematocrit, n’okufulumya omusulo.
Yoruba: Àwọn ìtọ́nisọ́nà Àjọ ìlera Àgbáyé gbà á ní ìmọ̀ràn láti ṣe àtúnṣe ìtànkáàkiri èyí tí ìgbéjáde mímí, àsìkò àtúnrọ iṣan tó ń gbé ẹ̀jẹ̀ kiri, ẹmatókirítì àti ìgbéjáde ìtọ̀ ṣe ìtọ́sọ́nà rẹ̀.
Zulu: Imihlahlandlela yeNhlangano Yezempilo Yomhlaba incoma ukubuyiselwa kokujikeleza okuqondiswa umfutho wokushaya kwenhliziyo, isikhathi sokugcwalisa i-capillary, i-hematocrit, kanye nokuphuma komchamo.
Hausa: Jagororin Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya sun bayar da shawarar maido da yawon jini ta hanyar bugun numfashi, lokacin cika jini da auna jan ƙwayar jini, da kuma fitowar fitsari.
Northern Sotho: Ditlhahli tša Mokgatlo wa Maphelo wa Lefase di šišinye gore go be le pušetšo ya go ela ga madi fao go hlahlwago ke kgatelelo ya go betha ga pelo, nako ya go tlatša madi ka megaladitšhikeng, hematokhriti, le tšweletšo ya moroto.
Amharic: የዓለም ጤና ድርጅት መመሪያዎች የደም ዝውውር ወደነበረበት እንዲመለስ በትርታ ግፊት፣ ጥቃቅን የደም ስሮች ደም መልሶ መሙያ ጊዜ፣ የቀይ ደም ህዋሳት ይዘት ምጣኔ፣ እና የሽንት ውጤት እንዲመሩ ይመክራል።

English: Large (>15 mL/kg) rapid (<30 min) fluid boluses should be avoided, but prompt fluid administration with crystalloids is essential and should be restricted as soon as the critical phase is over to avoid pulmonary edema.
Luganda: Okuteeka ebyamazzi (>15 mL/kg) ebingi ate ku mbiro (eddakiika <30) kirina okwewalibwa, naye okuteeka ebyamazzi omuli crystalloids kyamugaso era kirina okukolebwa mu kipimo kasita ekiseera eky’obulabe kiggwaawo olw’okwewala ekizibu ky’amazzi amangi mu mawuggwe.
Yoruba: Ńlá (>15 ml/kg) ìyára (<30 min) kí a yẹ́ra fún fluid boluses, ṣùgbọ́n gbígba omi kíákía pẹ̀lú crystalloids ṣe pàtàkì, kí wọ́n sì dáa dúró ní kété tí àsìkò tí ó le koko bá ti kọjá láti dènà àpọ̀jù omi nínú Ẹ̀dọ̀ fóóró.
Zulu: Amabholisi amakhulu (>15 mL/kg) asheshayo (<30 min) kufanele agwenywe, kodwa ukuphuza uketshezi ngokushesha ngama-crystalloids kubalulekile futhi kufanele kukhawulelwe ngokushesha lapho isigaba esibucayi siphela ukuze kugwenywe i-pulmonary edema.
Hausa: Ya kamata a kauce wa manyan magungunan bolus na ƙarin ruwa (>15 mL/kg) mai sauri (<30 minti), amma gaggawar ƙarin ruwa da crystalloids yana da mahimmanci kuma ya kamata a iyakance shi da zarar lokaci mai tsanani ya ƙare domin kauce wa kumburin huhu.
Northern Sotho: Diela tša dijo tše kgolo (>15 mL/kg) tša ka pela (<30 min) di swanetše go efogwa, eupša go tsenywa diela ka pela ka dikhristaloite go bohlokwa ebile go swanetše go iletšw aka pela ka fao go kgonagalago ge kgato ye bohlokwa e fedile go efoga go ruruga ga maswafo.
Amharic: ትልቅ (>15 ሚሊ/ኪግ) ፈጣን (<30 ደቂቃ) የቦሉሶች ፈሳሽ መወገድ አለበት፣ ነገር ግን በክሪስታልሎይድ ፈጣን ፈሳሽ አስተዳደር አስፈላጊ ነው እና የሳንባ እብጠትን ለማስወገድ ወሳኙ ደረጃ እንዳለቀ መገደብ አለበት።

English: Corticosteroids are not recommended, neither is platelet transfusion for thrombocytopenia in the absence of active bleeding or other risk factors.
Luganda: Corticosteroids tekisembebwa, wamu ne platelet transfusion olwa thrombocytopenia bwe kiba nga tewali kuvaamu musaayi oba obuzibu obulala.
Yoruba: A kò gbàá ní ìyànjú láti lo oògùn corticosteroids, bákàn náà ni fífa ẹ̀jẹ̀sínilára láti inú egungun fún thromcocytopenia (àdínkù ̀ẹjẹ̀ lára) ní ibi tí kò ti sí ìṣòfò ẹ̀jẹ̀ tàbí àwọn ewu mìíràn.
Zulu: I-Corticosteroids ayinconywa, kanjalo nokumpontshelwa kweplatelet ye-thrombocytopenia lapho kungekho ukopha okusebenzayo noma ezinye izici eziyingozi.
Hausa: Ba a bayar da shawarar Magungunan kumburi ba, kuma ba a yin ƙarin jar ƙyawar jini don ƙarancin jar ƙwayar jini idan babu zubar jini mai gudana ko wasu abubuwan haɗari ba.
Northern Sotho: Corticosteroids ga di šišinywe, le ge e ka ba go tsenya pholaselete ya thrombocytopenia ge go se na madi ao a tšwago goba mabaka a mangwe a kotsi.
Amharic: ትኩስ የደም መፍሰስ ወይም ሌሎች አደገኛ ሁኔታዎች በሌሉበት ጊዜ እብጠትን ለማከም የሚሰጡ መድኃኒቶች (ኮርቲኮስቴሮይድስ) አይመከሩም፣ እንዲሁም ለ የእንክብሊተ ደም ቁጥሮች ማነስ (ትሮምቦሳይቶፔኒያ) እንክብሊተ ደምን (ፕሌትሌቶች) መቅዳት አይመከርም።

Luganda: Abanoonyereza basemba enkyukakyuka ku bujjanjabi bw’eccupa olw’okujjanjaba abalwadde b’omusujja gw’ensiri ne n’omusujja gwa dengue in Afirika

English: Researchers advise against putting malaria and dengue patients on a drip to give them fluids where possible, even though it is recommended in the international treatment guidelines.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bawa amagezi obutawa bujjanjabi bwaccupa ku balwadde b’omusujja gw’ensiri n’omusujja gwa dengue wabula babawe ebyokunywa buli we kisobokera, ne bwe kiba nga kisembebwa mu bigobererwa mu bujjanjabi bw’ensi yonna.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí gbàá ní ìmọ̀ràn kí wọ́n máse fa omi sí àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n ní ibà àti iba dengue lára ní ìgbà gbogbo, kódà tí àwọn ìtọ́niṣọ́nà ilè òkèrè bá fi ọwọ́ sí èyí.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bayeluleka ngokumelene nokufaka iziguli zikamalaleveva kanye nodenga kwi-driphu ukuze zibanike uketshezi lapho kungenzeka khona, nakuba kutuswa eziqondisweni zokwelapha zamazwe ngamazwe.
Hausa: Masu bincike sun gargaɗi game amfani da bututun ƙarin ruwa ga majinyatan zazzaɓin cizon sauro da kuma zazzaɓi karya ƙashi don ba saka ruwa a duk inda zai yiwu, ko da yake an bayar da shawarar hakan a cikin ƙa’idojin jiyya na duniya.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba eletša kgahlanong le go bea balwetši ba letadi le ba dengue ditiriping go ba fa diela fao go kgonagalago, le ge e le gore go a šišinywa ka go ditlhahli tša kalafo tša boditšhabatšhaba.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች ምንም እንኳን በአለም አቀፍ የህክምና መመሪያዎች ውስጥ ቢመከርም፣ የወባ እና የዴንጊ ህመምተኞች በተቻለ መጠን ፈሳሽ በጠብታ ቦታ ላይ እንዲሰጣቸው እንዳይደረጉ ይመክራሉ።

English: A drip is a small plastic tube with one end inserted directly into a patient’s bloodstream using a needle, and the other end connected to a bag of fluid or medicine, which then “drips” directly into that patient’s bloodstream through the tube.
Luganda: Okuteekebwa ku ccupa kaba kaseke akatono ng’oludda olumu olumu lusonsekebwa n’empiso mu misuwa gy’omulwadde ate oludda olulala ne lusonsekebwa mu kisawo ky’amazzi oba eddagala, olwo ne litandika “okutonnya” butereevu mu musaayi gw’omulwadde nga liyita mu kaseke.
Yoruba: Dírípù jẹ́ túùbù ike kékeré kan pẹ̀lú àfibọ̀ igun kan tààrà wọ inú ìṣan ẹ̀jẹ̀ aláìsàn pẹ̀lú lílo abẹ́rẹ́, nígbàtí igun keji sì so pọ̀ mọ́ àpò omi tàbí oògùn, èyí tí ó wá ń kán “dírípù” tààrà láti ara túùbù, wọ inú ìṣan ẹ̀jẹ̀ aláìsàn.
Zulu: I-drip iyishubhu lepulasitiki elincane elinengxenye eyodwa efakwe ngokuqondile egazini lesiguli kusetshenziswa inaliti, futhi enye ixhunywe esikhwameni soketshezi noma imithi, ebese “iconsa” ngokuqondile egazini laleso siguli ngeshubhu.
Hausa: Bututun ƙarin ruwa wani ƙaramin bututu ne na robar filastik wanda ake saka wa a ƙarshen ɗaya kai-tsaye a cikin hanyar jinin majiyyaci ta hanyar amfani da allura, ɗayan kuma ana haɗa shi da jakar ruwa ko magani, wanda sai ya “ɗigo” kai-tsaye cikin jinin wannan majiyyaci ta cikin bututun.
Northern Sotho: Teripi ke tšhupu ye nnyane ya polastiki yeo mafelelong a yona ka lehlakoreng le tee a tsenywago thwii go tshepedišo ya madi a molwetši ka go šomiša tšhwana, mola lmafelelo a lehlakore le lengwe a kgokagantšwe le mokotlana wa diela goba wa dihlare, gomme sehlare seo se “rothela” thwii ka gare ga tshepedišo ya madi a molwetši ka go diriša tšhupu yeo.
Amharic: ጠብታ ማለት አንዱ ጫፍ በቀጥታ በታካሚው ደም ውስጥ በመርፌ የሚገባ ሲሆን ሌላኛው ጫፍ ደግሞ ከፈሳሽ ወይም ከመድኃኒት ከረጢት ጋር የተገናኘ ሲሆን ከዚያም በቱቦው ውስጥ በቀጥታ ወደ በታካሚው ደም ውስጥ "ይንጠባጠባል"።

English: Malaria and dengue fever are diseases that affect many people in Africa.
Luganda: Omusujja gw’ensiri n’omusujja dengue bulwadde obukosa abantu abangi mu Afirika.
Yoruba: Ibà àti ibà dengue jẹ́ àwọn àìsàn tí ó máa ń yọ àwọn ènìyàn Africa lẹ́nu.
Zulu: Umalaleveva nodenga yizifo ezihlasela abantu abaningi e-Afrika.
Hausa: Zazzaɓin cizon sauro da zazzaɓi karya ƙashi cututtuka ne suke shafar mutane da dama a Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Letadi le dengue ke malwetši ao a amago batho ba bantši ka Afrika.
Amharic: ወባ እና የዴንጊ ትኩሳት በአፍሪካ ውስጥ ብዙ ሰዎችን የሚያጠቁ በሽታዎች ናቸው።

English: Doctors are given standard guidelines on how to treat patients, but some doctors have observed that patients in poorer countries respond differently to drip treatment than those in Western countries.
Luganda: Abasawo baweebwa ebyokugoberera eby’olugerero ku ngeri y’okujjanjaba abalwadde, naye abasawo abamu beetegerezza abalwadde mu mawanga agamu amaavu nti gakola ebintu byanjawulo ku bujjanjabi bw’eccupa bw’ogeraageranya ku obwo obukozesebwa mu Mawanga g’e Bulaaya.
Yoruba: Wọ́n fún àwọn dókítà ní ìtọ́nisọ́nà tí ó dáńgájíá lóríi bí wọ́n ṣe máa ṣe ìtọ́jú àwọn aláìsàn, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn dókítà kan ti ṣe àkíyèsí pé bí ara àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n wà ní orílẹ̀ èdè tí ó tálákà ṣe máa ń ṣiṣẹ́ pẹ̀lú ìlànà ìwòsàn ìlò omi yàtọ̀ sí àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n wà ní àwọn orílẹ̀ èdè tí ó lọ́rọ̀.
Zulu: Odokotela banikezwa iziqondiso ezivamile zendlela yokwelapha iziguli, kodwa abanye odokotela baye baphawula ukuthi iziguli zasemazweni ampofu zisabela ngendlela ehlukile ekwelashweni nge-drip kunalezo zamazwe aseNtshonalanga.
Hausa: Ana ba wa likitoci daidaitattun ƙa’idoji game da yadda za a yi wa marasa lafiya magani, amma wasu likitocin sun lura cewa marasa lafiya a ƙasashe masu fama da talauci jikinsu na karɓar ƙarin ruwa daban da marasa lafiya na ƙasashen Yamma.
Northern Sotho: Dingaka di fiwa ditlhahli tše di swanago mabapi le ka fao ba ka alafago balwetši, eupša dingaka tše dingwe di lemogile gore balwetši bao ba tšwago ka dinageng tše di hlokago ba arabela ka fao go fapanego go kalafo ka diterepi go fetwa ke ba ka dinageng tša ka Bodikela.
Amharic: ዶክተሮች ለታካሚዎች እንዴት እንደሚታከሙ መደበኛ መመሪያዎች ተሰጥቷቸዋል፣ ነገር ግን አንዳንድ ዶክተሮች በድሃ አገሮች ውስጥ ያሉ ታካሚዎች በምዕራባውያን አገሮች ከሚገኙት የበለጠ ለጠብታ ህክምና የተለየ ምላሽ እንደሚሰጡ አስተውለዋል።

English: So, in this book chapter, the authors reviewed the current guidelines for managing malaria and dengue fever, and made some recommendations for poor countries.
Luganda: Kale nno, mu kitabo kino, abawandiisi beekaliriza ebigobererwa mu kiseera kino okujjanjaba omusujja gw’ensiri n’omusujja dengue, era ne babaako bye basemba okulebwa mu mawanga agakyakula.
Yoruba: Fún ìdí èyi, nínú orí ìwé yìí, àwọn oǹkọ̀wé ṣe àtúngbéyẹ̀wò àwọn ìtọ́nisọ́nà fún ìṣàkósò àìsàn ibà àti ibà dengue, wọ́n si mú àwọn àmọ̀ràn kọ̀ọ̀kan wah fún àwọn orílẹ̀ èdè tí ó tálákà.
Zulu: Ngakho-ke, kulesi sahluko sencwadi, ababhali bokufunda baqondise zamanje zamanje zokubhala umalaleveva nomkhuhlane wodenga, futhi benza i ukulungisa ampofu.
Hausa: Don haka, a wannan babi na littafi, marubutan sun yi bitar ƙa’idojin da ake bi na magance zazzaɓin cizon sauro da zazzaɓi karya ƙashi, kuma sun bayar da wasu shawarwari ga ƙasashe matalauta.
Northern Sotho: Ka fao, ka mo gare ga kgaolo ye ya ka pukung, bangwadi ba lekodišišitše ditlhahli tša bjale tša go laola bolwetši bja letadi le dengue, gomme ba dira ditšhišinyo go dinaga tše di hlokago.
Amharic: ስለዚህ፣ በዚህ የመፅሃፍ ምእራፍ ውስጥ፣ ደራሲዎቹ የወባን እና የዴንጊ ትኩሳትን ለመቆጣጠር ወቅታዊ መመሪያዎችን ገምግመዋል፣ እና ለድሃ ሀገሮች አንዳንድ ምክሮችን ሰጥተዋል።

English: The authors said doctors needed to test for malaria by checking for the actual disease-causing malaria parasites in the patient’s blood.
Luganda: Abawandiisi baagamba nti abasawo baali beetaaga okukebera omusujja nga bakeberera ddala obulwadde bwennyini obuleese akawuka k’omusujja gw’ensiri mu musaayi gw’omulwadde.
Yoruba: Àwọn oǹkọ̀wé sọ pé àwọn dókítà nílò la†I ṣe àyèwò fún ibà nípa ṣíṣe àyẹ̀wò fún àìsàn gàn ní pàtó tó ń ṣe okùnfà àfòmọ́ màlaéríà nínú ẹ̀jẹ̀ àwọn aláìsàn.
Zulu: Ababhali bathi odokotela kudingeka bahlole umalaleveva ngokubheka izimuncagazi ezibangela isifo egazini lesiguli.
Hausa: Marubutan sun ce akwai buƙatar likitoci su yi gwajin cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro ta hanyar duba ainihin ƙwayoyin cutar da suke haifar da cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro a cikin jinin mara lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba boletše gore dingaka di swanetše go dira diteko tša letadi ka go lekola dipharasaete tša letadi tšeo di tlogago di baka bolwetši bjo ka mading a molwetši.
Amharic: ደራሲዎቹ ዶክተሮች በታካሚው ደም ውስጥ በትክክል በሽታን የሚያስከትሉ የወባ ጥገኛ ተህዋስያንን በመፈተሽ የወባ በሽታን መመርመር አለባቸው ብለዋል።

English: If parasites are found, patients should be given medication right away.
Luganda: Obuwuka bwe buzuulibwa, abalwadde balina okumuwa eddagala amangu ddala.
Yoruba: Tí wọ́n bá rí àfòmọ́, kíákíá ni kí wọ́n fún àwọn aláìsàn ní oògùn.
Zulu: Uma kutholakala ama-parasite, iziguli kufanele zinikezwe imithi ngokushesha.
Hausa: Idan an sami ƙwayoyin cutar, ya kamata a ba marasa lafiya magani nan-da-nan.
Northern Sotho: Ge dipharasaete di ka hwetšwa, balwetši ba swanetše go fiwa dihlare semeetseng.
Amharic: ጥገኛ ተህዋስያን ከተገኙ፣ ታካሚዎች ወዲያውኑ መድኃኒት ሊሰጣቸው ይገባል።

English: They said patients should only be given fluids or medication through a drip if they have lost a lot of blood and their heart is not pumping enough blood.
Luganda: Baagamba nti abalwadde balina okuweebwa ebyokunywa oba eddagala mu ccupa bwe baba nga bavuddemu omusaayi mungi era ng’omutima gwabwe tegukuba musaayi gumala.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé tí àwọn aláìsàn bá ti pàdánù ẹ̀jẹ̀ tí ó pọ̀ tí ọkàn wọn kò sì gbé ẹ̀jẹ̀ wọlé dáadáa nìkan ni kí wọn fún wọ́n ní omi tàbí oògùn láti ara díríìpù.
Zulu: Bathe iziguli kumele zinikezwe uketshezi noma imishanguzo nge-drip kuphela uma zilahlekelwe yigazi eliningi futhi nenhliziyo ingampompa igazi elanele.
Hausa: Sun ce ya kamata a ba marasa lafiya ruwa ko magani ta bututun ƙarin ruwa ne kawai idan sun zubar da jini mai yawa kuma zuciyarsu ba ta fitar da isasshen jini.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore balwetši ba swanetše go fiwa diela goba dihlare fela ka teripi ge e le gore ba lahlegetšwe ke madi a mantši le ge pelo ya bona e sa pompe madi ao a lekanego.
Amharic: ለታካሚዎች ብዙ ደም ከፈሰሳቸው እና ልባቸው በቂ ደም ካልገፋ ብቻ ፈሳሽ ወይም መድኃኒት በጠብታ መልኩ ሊሰጣቸው ይገባል ብለዋል።

English: They also suggested that if given, doctors should reduce the usual volume in patients who are taking other fluids on the side.
Luganda: Era baateesa nti eddagala bwe ligabwa mu ngeri eyo, abasawo balina okukendeeza ku bungi obwabulijjo mu balwadde abafuna ebyokunywa ebirala okwongereza ku ddagala.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún gbàá ní ìyànjú pé tí wọ́n bá fún wọn, kí àwọn dókítà mú àdínkù bá iye tí wọ́n ń fún àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n ń gba omi mìíràn ní ẹ̀gbẹ́kẹ̀gbẹ́.
Zulu: Baphinde baphakamisa ukuthi uma benikezwa, odokotela kufanele behlise umthamo ojwayelekile ezigulini eziphuza olunye uketshezi eceleni.
Hausa: Har ila yau, sun bayar da shawarar cewa idan aka ba su, likitoci su rage yawan adadin da aka saba yi a marasa lafiya da suke shan wasu ruwa a gefe guda.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba šišinya gape gore ge e le gore diela di a fiwa, dingaka di swanetše go fokotša bontši bjo bo tlwaelegilego bja diela ka mading a balwetši bao ba hwetšago diela tše dingwe ka thokong ye nngwe.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም ከሚሰጣቸው ከሆነ፣ ዶክተሮች በጎን በኩል ሌሎች ፈሳሾችን በሚወስዱ ታካሚዎች ላይ የተለመደውን መጠን እንዲቀንሱ ሐሳብ አቅርበዋል።

English: They said if patients were unable to eat by themselves, the doctors could start giving them food through feeding tubes only after 2 and a half days.
Luganda: Bagamba nti abalwadde bawe baba tebasobola kweriisa, abasawo basobola okutandika okubaweera emmere mu buseke nga wamaze okuyitawo ennaku 2 n’ekitundu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ní bí àwọn aláìsàn kò bá lè dah oúnjẹ́ jẹ fún ara wọ́n, àwọn dókítà le è bẹ̀rẹ̀ lati fún wọn ní oúnjẹ́ nípa lílò túùbù ìfúnnilóúnjẹ léyìn ọjọ́ 2 àbọ̀ péré.
Zulu: Bathe uma iziguli zingakwazi ukudla zodwa, odokotela bangaqala bazinike ukudla ngamapayipi kuphela ngemuva kwezinsuku ezi-2 nesigamu.
Hausa: Sun ce idan marasa lafiya ba za su iya cin abinci da kansu ba, likitoci za su iya fara ba su abinci ta bututun ciyarwa kawai ne bayan kwanaki 2 da rabi.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore ge e le gore balwetši ba palelwa ke go ja ka bobona, dingaka di ka thoma go ba fa dijo ka go šomiša ditšhupu tša go fepa ka dijo fela ka morago ga matšatši a 2 le seripagare.
Amharic: ታካሚዎች በራሳቸው መብላት ካልቻሉ፣ ዶክተሮቹ በመመገቢያ ቱቦዎች ምግብ ሊሰጧቸው የሚችሉት ከ2 ቀን ተኩል በኋላ ነው ብለዋል።

English: The authors also said where patients had cerebral malaria that affected the brain, patients should be carefully allowed to get enough air to avoid brain swelling.
Luganda: Abawandiisi era baagamba nti abalwadde bwe baba nga balina omusujja gw’oku bwongo era nga gukosezza obwongo, abalwadde balina okuweebwa ekyanya ne bafuna omukka empewo emala olw’okwewala obwongo okuzimba.
Yoruba: Àwọn oǹkọ̀wé tún sọ pé ní ibi tí àwọn aláìsàn bá ti ní ní ibà ajẹmọ́pọlọ, èyí tí ó ní ipa lórí ọpọlọ, ó yẹ kí wọ́n máa fi ọgbọọgbọ́n fún àwọn aláìsàn ní àyè léti gba àfẹ́fẹ́ kí ọpọlọ wọn má baà wú.
Zulu: Ababhali baphinde bathi lapho iziguli zine-malaria yobuchopho ethinta ubuchopho, iziguli kufanele zivunyelwe ngokucophelela ukuze zithole umoya owanele ukugwema ukuvuvukala kobuchopho.
Hausa: Marubutan sun kuma ce a inda majiyyata suke da zazzaɓin cizon sauro da ya shafi ƙwaƙwalwa, ya kamata a riƙa barin marasa lafiya a hankali su samu isasshiyar iska don gujewa kumburin ƙwaƙwalwa.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba boletše gape gore ge balwetši ba na le letadi la megalatšhika ya bjoko leo le amago bjoko, balwetši ka šedi ba swanetše go dumelela go hwetša moya wo o lekanego go efoga go ruruga ga bjoko.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም ደራሲዎቹ ታካሚዎች አንጎልን የሚጎዳ ሴሬብራል ወባ ካለባቸው፣ ታካሚዎች የአንጎል እብጠትን ለማስወገድ በቂ አየር እንዲያገኙ በጥንቃቄ መፍቀድ አለባቸው።

English: The authors said for dengue disease, doctors should not give patients lots of fluid through drips, but if needed it should be done more slowly.
Luganda: Abawandiisi baagamba nti bwo obulwadde bwa dengue, abalwadde tebalina kuweebwa byamazzi bingi kuyitira mu ccupa, naye bwe kiba nga kyetaagisa, kirina kukolebwa mpola mpola ddala.
Yoruba: Àwọn oǹkọ̀wé sọ pé, fún àìsàn dengue, kí àwọn dókítà máṣe fún àwọn aláìsàn ní omi tí ó pọ̀ láti ara dírípù, ṣùgbọ́n tí ó bá wúlò, kí wọhn fi sùúrù ṣe é.
Zulu: Ababhali bathi ngesifo sodenga, odokotela akumele banike iziguli uketshezi oluningi ngama-drip, kodwa uma kudingeka kufanele kwenziwe kancane.
Hausa: Marubutan sun ce game da cutar zazzaɓi karya ƙashi, likitoci ba za su ba marasa lafiya ruwa mai yawa ta bututun ƙarin ruwa ba, amma idan an buƙata ya kamata a yi hakan a hankali.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba boletše gore go bolwetši bja dengue, dingaka ga se tša swanela go fa balwetši diela tše ntši ka diteripi, eupša ge go nyakega se se swanetše go dirwa ka go nanya kudu.
Amharic: ደራሲዎቹ ለዴንጊ በሽታ ዶክተሮች ለታካሚዎች ብዙ ፈሳሽ በጠብታዎች መስጠት የለባቸውም፣ ነገር ግን አስፈላጊ ከሆነ ቀስ በቀስ መደረግ አለበት ብለዋል።

English: They said doctors should be quick to put dengue patients on drip, but should stop when the patient gets better to avoid a condition where the fluids get into the lungs.
Luganda: Baagamba nti abasawo balina okwanguwa okuteeka abalwadde ba dengue ku ccupa, nti naye balina okukikomya ng’omulwadde assuuse olw’okwewala embeera amazzi okugenda mu mawuggwe.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ní kí àwọn dókítà yára láti fún àwọn aláìsàn tí wọn ni dengue ni dírípù,ṣùgbọ́n ní kété tí ara aláìsàn bá ti yah díẹ̀, kí wọn dáwọ́ rẹ̀ dúró kí wọ́n le è yẹrẹ fún ipò tí omi fi máa wọ inú ẹ̀dọ̀ fóóró aláìsàn.
Zulu: Bathe odokotela kufanele basheshe bafake iziguli zodenga i-drip, kodwa kufanele bayeke uma isiguli siba ngcono ukuze kugwenywe isimo lapho uketshezi lungena emaphashini.
Hausa: Sun ce ya kamata likitoci su yi gaggawar sanya majinyatan zazzaɓi karya ƙashi a kan butun ƙarin ruwa, amma su dakata a lokacin da majiyyaci ya samu sauƙi domin guje wa yanayin da ruwan yake shiga cikin huhu.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore dingaka di swanetše go dira ka pela go bea balwetši ba dengue diteripi, gomme ba swanetše go emiša ge molwetši a eba kaone go efoga seemo seo ka sona diela di ka tsenago ka maswafong.
Amharic: ዶክተሮች የዴንጊ ሕመምተኞችን በጠብታ ላይ ለማድረግ ፈጣን መሆን አለባቸው፣ ነገር ግን ፈሳሾቹ ወደ ሳንባ ውስጥ የሚገቡበትን ሁኔታ ለማስወገድ በሽተኛው ሲሻለው ማቆም አለባቸው ብለዋል።

English: They also said if the patient did not bleed, it was not necessary to give them blood.
Luganda: Era baagamba nti omulwadde bw’aba nga tavuddeemu musaayi, kyali tekyetaagisa kumuteekako musaayi.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún sọ pé, tí aláìsàn kò bá sun ẹ̀jẹ̀ lára, kò nílò kí wọ́n fa ẹ̀jẹ̀ sí wọn lára.
Zulu: Baphinde bathi uma isiguli singopha asikho isidingo sokuthi simnike igazi.
Hausa: Sun kuma ce idan majiyyaci bai zubar da jini ba, ba lallai ba ne a ƙara masa jini ba.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gape gore ge e le gore molwetši ga se a tšwa madi, go be go sa hlokagale go ba abela madi.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም በሽተኛው ደም ካልፈሰሰው፣ ደም መስጠት አስፈላጊ አይደለም ብለዋል።

English: They said large volumes of liquids through a drip should only be given if patients had low blood pressure.
Luganda: Baagamba nti okuteekebwako amazzi amangi mu ccupa kirina kukolebwa abalwadde bwe baba nga balina puleesa eyawansi.
Yoruba: Wọn sọ pé ìdá omi tí ó pọ̀ tí wọ́n yóò fún aláìsàn tí ìfúnpa rẹ̀ lọlẹ̀ jù gbọdò wá láti ara dírípù nìkan.
Zulu: Bathe umthamo omkhulu woketshezi nge-drip kufanele unikezwe kuphela uma iziguli zinomfutho wegazi ophansi.
Hausa: Sun ce ya kamata a ba da ruwa mai yawa ta ɗigon ruwa kawai idan marasa lafiya suna da ƙarancin hawan jini.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore palo ye kgolo ya diela tšeo di abjago ka teripi di swanetše go fiwa fela ge balwetši ba na le kgatelelo ya fase ya madi.
Amharic: ከፍተኛ መጠን ያለው ፈሳሽ በጠብታ መሰጠት ያለበት ታካሚዎች ዝቅተኛ የደም ግፊት ካላቸው ብቻ ነው ብለዋል።

English: They said for patients with less blood but good blood pressure, doctors should not put them on drip.
Luganda: Baagamba nti abalwadde abalina omusaayi omutono naye nga puleesa yaabwe nnungi, abasawo tebateekwa kubateeka ku ccupa.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé, fún àwọn aláìsàn tí ẹ̀jẹ̀ kò pọ̀ tó ní ara wọn, ṣùgbọ́n tí ìfúnpá wọn dára, àwọn dokítà kò gbọdọ̀ fún wọn ní dírípù.
Zulu: Bathe ezigulini ezinegazi elincane kodwa ezinomfutho wegazi ophakeme, odokotela akumele bazifake i-drip.
Hausa: Sun ce ga marasa lafiya da suke da ƙarancin jini amma mai gudana da kyau, bai kamata likitoci su sanya su a bututun ƙarin ruwa ba.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore go balwetši bao ba nago le madi a mannyane eupša ba na le kgatelelo ya madi ye kaone, dingaka ga se tša swanela go ba bea go diteripi.
Amharic: ዶክተሮች አነስተኛ ደም ላለባቸው ነገር ግን ጥሩ የደም ግፊት ላላቸው ታካሚዎች ጠብታ ላይ ማድረግ የለባቸውም ብለዋል።

English: They also recommended that doctors should not give dengue patients any medicine that reduced swelling.
Luganda: Era baasemba nti abasawo tebalina kuwa balwadde ba dengue ddagala lyonna erikendeeza ku kuzimba.
Yoruba: Wọn tún gbà á ní ìyànjú pé, àwọn dókítà kò gbọdọ̀ fún àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n ní dengue ní èyíkéyìí oògun tí ó le è mú ara wíwú wálẹ̀.
Zulu: Baphinde batusa ukuthi odokotela akufanele banikeze iziguli zodenga noma yimuphi umuthi onciphisa ukuvuvukala.
Hausa: Sun kuma bayar da shawarar cewa kada likitoci su bai wa masu fama da cutar zazzaɓi karya ƙashi duk wani maganin da zai rage kumburi.
Northern Sotho: Ba šišintše gape gore dingaka ga se tša swanela go fa balwetši ba dengue dihlare dife goba dife tšeo di fokotšago go ruruga.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም ዶክተሮች እብጠትን የሚቀንስ ምንም ዓይነት መድኃኒት ለዴንጊ ሕመምተኞች እንዳይሰጡ ይመክራሉ።

English: Doctors should avoid giving patients blood where possible because patients may be allergic and or may be exposed to other disease-causing microorganisms in this way.
Luganda: Abasawo balina okwewala okuwa abalwadde omusaayi we kisobokera kubanga abalwadde bayinza okuba nga balina ekyoka oba bayinza okuba nga balina ebirwadde ebirala ebireeta obuwuka mu ngeri eyo.
Yoruba: Kí àwọn dókítà yẹra fún fífún àwọn aláìsàn ní ẹ̀jẹ̀ ní ìgbà gbogbo nítorí pé ó ṣe é ṣe kí aláìsàn ní àìbáléramu tàbí kí wọ́n kó àwọn àrùn mìíràn – èyí tí yóò ṣe okùnfà àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí kékèké ní ọ̀nà yìí.
Zulu: Odokotela kufanele bakugweme ukunikeza iziguli igazi lapho kungenzeka khona ngoba iziguli zingase zingazwani nomzimba futhi noma zingase zichayeke kwamanye amagciwane abangela izifo ngale ndlela.
Hausa: Likitoci su guji ba marasa lafiya jini a inda zai yiwu domin majiyyata suna iya zama masu borin jini ko kuma suna iya kamuwa da wasu ƙananan halittu masu haifar da cututtuka ta wannan hanya.
Northern Sotho: Dingaka di swanetše go efoga go abela balwetši madi ka fao go kgonagalago ka ge balwetši ba ka ba le aletši le goba ba ka fetelwa ke bolwetši bja go bakwa ke diphedinyana ka tsela ye.
Amharic: ዶክተሮች በተቻለ መጠን ለታካሚዎች ደም ከመስጠት መቆጠብ አለባቸው ምክንያቱም ታካሚዎች አለርጂ ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ ወይም በዚህ መንገድ ለሌሎች በሽታ አምጪ ተህዋሲያን ሊጋለጡ ይችላሉ።

English: Doctors should only give blood if the patient lost a lot of blood.
Luganda: Abasawo balina okuteeka omusaayi ku mulwadde omulwadde bw’aba ng’avuddemu omusaayi mungi ddala.
Yoruba: Nígbàtí àwọn aláìsàn bá ti pàdábù ẹ̀jẹ̀ nìkan ní kí àwọn dókítà fún wọn ní ẹ̀jẹ̀.
Zulu: Odokotela kufanele banikeze igazi kuphela uma isiguli silahlekelwe igazi eliningi.
Hausa: Likitoci yakamata su ba da jini ne kawai idan majiyyaci ya rasa jini mai yawa.
Northern Sotho: Dingaka di swanetše go aba madi ge e le gore molwetši o lahlegetšwe ke madi a mantši.
Amharic: ዶክተሮች ደም መስጠት ያለባቸው በሽተኛው ብዙ ደም ከፈሰሰው ብቻ ነው።

English: The authors cautioned that sometimes they did not have enough information to make recommendations.
Luganda: Abawandiisi baalabula nti olumu baali tebalina bubaka bumala kusinziira kukola bisembebwa.
Yoruba: Àwọn oǹkọ̀wé kìí nílọ̀ pé ní ìgbà mìíràn àwọn kò ní ìfitóniléti tí ó pọ̀ tó láti le è mú ìmọ̀ràn wá.
Zulu: Ababhali baxwayise ngokuthi kwesinye isikhathi abanalo ulwazi olwanele lokwenza izincomo.
Hausa: Marubutan sun yi gargaɗin cewa a wasu lokuta ba su da isasshen bayani domin bayar da shawarwari.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba eleditše gore ka dinako tše dingwe ba be ba se na tshedimošo ye e lekanego ya go dira ditšhišinyo.
Amharic: አንዳንድ ጊዜ ምክሮችን ለመስጠት እነሱም በቂ መረጃ እንደሌላቸው ደራሲዎቹ አሳስበዋል።

English: The researchers were from institutions in Uganda, South Africa, Thailand, the UK, the Netherlands, Vietnam, Austria, and India.
